contentText: European foreign ministers on Friday used a G7 meeting with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio to press the case that Russia was helping Iran target US forces in the Middle East war. Rubio joined the second day of the gathering of ministers of leading Western democracies, taking place amid wars ​in Iran and Ukraine, ‌economic uncertainty and mounting unease over unpredictable US foreign policy under Donald Trump. FRANCE 24's International Affairs Commentator Douglas Herbert tells us more.
